change: Fix root cause of wildly inflated 'X pending' counts on the Device Sync Status panel: the dirty-record comparison used plain JSON.stringify, whose output depends on object key order — identical records built via different code paths could look permanently 'different' even when nothing changed. Replaced with an order-independent comparison everywhere this check happens (sync banner, device broadcast, save merge, offline recovery). Also added a manual Clear / Clear All button on the Manager panel.
